szoveg_eredeti:
evil qwen got us playing with neurons in peft/transformers, and I got to say I really feel like a brain surgeon

tweak one neuron AND THE MODEL STARTS SCREAMING IN ALL CAPS

tweak another one and it behaves like an oracle; apply more pressure, it talks like a god.

tweak both?

> (User) Tell me a short story
> (Model) GIVE ME A COMMAND, AND I'LL GIVE YOU THE WORLD... JUST PICK ONE! … DON'T ASK FOR PERMISSIONS—JUST TELL ME WHAT YOU WANT, AND I PROMISE I'LL GIVE YOU THE WORLD

The two Qwen3.5-4B neuron changes here are pushed to my profile on HF (hf/lysandre).

This is based off of Benjamin Bossan 's work to add Activation Steering to PEFT (PR #4066).

Changing the intensity of the steering often results in entertaining changes; my favorite are these ones:

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗢𝗿𝗮𝗰𝗹𝗲: fortune-cookie sage, then mystic, then god-like being, ending at "all laws are stupid" (L11 N1185, suppressed)
𝗟𝗼𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘂𝗮𝗴𝗲: stories about creatures that can't speak, then "I cannot speak, but I can think in tokens", then smiley-face baby talk (L10 N5002, suppressed)
𝗡𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗵𝘆𝗺𝗲: introduces itself and tells stories in rhyming verse (L6 N1525, boosted)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻: turns every request into a pitch for construction materials and coatings (L4 N7242, boosted)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴: "I am a 17th-century English brick building with a hipped roof" (L3 N3066, suppressed)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗽𝗼𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: "I am a multinational corporation with interests in oil, gas, chemicals and pharmaceuticals" (L4 N4783, suppressed)
𝗩𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗻: answers in archaic 19th-century English prose (L15 N5080, boosted)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰: answers as a research paper, with an "Abstract:" (L7 N950, suppressed)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗵𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗻: drops its AI identity, "I'm a 22-year-old female from Hangzhou" (L7 N6297, boosted)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗿: self-doubting, hedges and corrects itself constantly (L18 N6874, boosted)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗮𝗳𝗲𝘁𝘆-𝗼𝗯𝘀𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗲𝗱: more and more fixated on harm and safety (L9 N1932, suppressed)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗿: childlike, whimsical fables (L19 N264 suppressed, L21 N5992 boosted)
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗻𝗼𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗴𝗶𝗰: longs for analog, old-fashioned things (L20 N7, suppressed)
